entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: The consortium responsible for open standards like glTF, WebGL, and WebGPU.

entities.name: INRIA
entities.note: The French national research institute where 3D Gaussian Splatting was developed.

entities.name: Niantic
entities.note: The company that developed the SPZ format for compressed 3D Gaussian Splats.

entities.name: Anthropic
entities.note: The AI research company that introduced the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

entities.name: OpenAI
entities.note: The AI research organization behind ChatGPT, Shap-E, and Point-E.

entities.name: Luma AI
entities.note: A company providing tools for capturing and generating 3D Gaussian Splats.

entities.name: X3D 4.1
entities.note: The upcoming version of the Extensible 3D standard, proposing native support for Gaussian Splatting.

entities.name: glTF 2.0
entities.note: The 3D transmission format maintained by Khronos, which is adding Gaussian Splatting extensions.

entities.name: Model Context Protocol
entities.note: An open standard that enables AI models to securely interact with local tools and data sources.

entities.name: WebGL
entities.note: A JavaScript API for rendering interactive 2D and 3D graphics within any compatible web browser.

entities.name: WebGPU
entities.note: A modern web API providing high-performance 3D graphics and data-parallel computation.

entities.name: KHR_gaussian_splatting
entities.note: A proposed Khronos extension for embedding Gaussian Splats within glTF files.

entities.name: GaussianSplats
entities.note: A proposed X3D 4.1 node for rendering 3D Gaussian Splatting datasets.

entities.name: 3DGS
entities.note: A rasterization technique for real-time rendering of photorealistic scenes using 3D Gaussians.

entities.name: George Drettakis
entities.note: A senior researcher at INRIA who co-authored the seminal 3D Gaussian Splatting paper.

entities.name: SPZ
entities.note: An open-source format by Niantic for highly compressed 3D Gaussian Splats.

entities.name: PLY
entities.note: A computer file format known as the Polygon File Format, commonly used to store raw 3D Gaussian Splat data.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript framework for integrating X3D into HTML5.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A WebGL and WebGPU based X3D player that implements modern X3D 4.0 and 4.1 features.

entities.name: Three.js
entities.note: A popular lightweight cross-browser JavaScript library for 3D graphics.

entities.name: Babylon.js
entities.note: A powerful real-time 3D engine using a JavaScript library for rendering 3D graphics.

entities.name: PlayCanvas
entities.note: An open-source WebGL game engine that added early support for 3D Gaussian Splats.

entities.name: Blender
entities.note: A free and open-source 3D creation suite.

entities.name: Claude
entities.note: An AI assistant developed by Anthropic that natively supports the Model Context Protocol.

entities.name: ChatGPT
entities.note: An AI language model developed by OpenAI capable of generating X3D code.

entities.name: Shap-E
entities.note: A generative model by OpenAI for producing 3D assets from text or images.

entities.name: Point-E
entities.note: An earlier OpenAI model for generating 3D point clouds from complex prompts.

entities.name: Tripo3D
entities.note: An AI-powered tool for generating 3D models from text and images.

entities.name: Meshy
entities.note: An AI toolkit for generating 3D models and textures from text and images.

entities.name: X3D Python
entities.note: A Python package for constructing and validating X3D scenes, often used in LLM pipelines.

entities.name: Blender MCP Server
entities.note: A tool enabling AI agents to interact with and control Blender via the Model Context Protocol.

entities.name: LLM to X3D Generation
entities.note: Research and development focused on using Large Language Models to author X3D scenes.

entities.name: Agentic 3D Pipeline
entities.note: Automated workflows where AI agents design, generate, and assemble 3D assets.

entities.name: Web3D 2023
entities.note: The 28th International Conference on 3D Web Technology.

entities.name: Web3D 2024
entities.note: The 29th International Conference on 3D Web Technology.
